mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_TIP_COMMENT (tip_id, user_id, content, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tipId}, #{userId}, #{content}, 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT comment_id AS commentId, tip_id AS tipId, user_id AS userId, content, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM TB_TIP_COMMENT WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.tip_id AS tipId, c.user_id AS userId, c.content, c.status, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt, u.nickname AS nickname, u.profile_img AS profileImg FROM TB_TIP_COMMENT c JOIN TB_USER u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.tip_id = #{tipId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_TIP_COMMENT SET content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE TB_TIP_COMMENT SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
